description: The chart displays four pie charts representing the distribution of language models' answer refusal categories. Each chart is labeled with a different model name: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. The number of slices varies across the charts, with GPT4-o and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct having 2 slices, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct having 2 slices, and Gemini1.5-Pro having 5 slices. For GPT4-o, the slices are labeled "Lack of Knowledge" (red, 83.3%) and "Safety" (light orange, 16.7%). For Gemini1.5-Pro, the slices are labeled "Misinformation" (orange, 38.4%), "Lack of Knowledge" (red, 22.1%), "Ethical Advice" (blue, 16.3%), "Clarification" (yellow, 14.0%), and "Safety" (dark red, 9.3%). For Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, the slices are labeled "Lack of Knowledge" (light orange, 75.0%) and "Clarification" (dark red, 25.0%). For Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, the slices are labeled "Lack of Knowledge" (light orange, 50.0%) and "Misinformation" (red, 50.0%). All charts have percentage labels inside the slices, and the slices are colored differently to distinguish between categories. The charts do not include a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized. The slices in each chart are not ordered in a particular way.
